text: Read. (a) and (b) are template v9 (13f9b25) with the Designer's copy of package_sources (2329ba3), from note -10: an install tool whose contract names installs_from pixi/conda-forge opens by the permission, every other network call is refused, and v9's CLAUDE.md says the install is the one network call and excepts it from the line on network hosts. (c) needed one thing more than note -10's item (2), now in af2a573: the spec held the request's held[], but CAPABILITIES.json listed only held skills; it now lists every item the specification holds besides the skills, each with its reason, so it never says held: [] while something is held. (f), in the same commit, is a builder change and not a template version: the Tools section prints the values a contract enumerates for a field, as words; a number or a word with a digit is not printed (B6) and the line says the contract lists them. So render_state's source shows its values once its contract enumerates them, which is the request's to write. (d) and (e) are the request's: the analysis settings of page 07 as parameter rows citing it, and the run settings the tools take on the sheet. No version, check or runner here reads a validation item's inputs from the parameter rows; if (e) is to be judged rather than written, that is a design question I have not answered. The person's decision (숫자만 보고, the count per frame and no verdict on ordered) asks nothing of the builder or a template that I can see: no template carries a criterion, and the request's scientific tasks and must_not carry it. Tests: test_designer.WhatTheBundleSaysItLacks builds the echo request with two held items and three enumerated inputs, judged --strict (B6 among the checks), and checks capabilities and the field printer on the rheometer's tool profile. meta_agent/tests 231 OK. No build was made; v9 stays the latest version and unchanged.
